newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Bell, Lucent in sales deal.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Bell, Lucent in sales deal.

text.p: Southwestern Bell Telephone Co said Wednesday it entered into a five-year agreement under which it will sell Lucent Technologies Inc business products in its traditional five-state region.

The agreement allows Southwestern Bell to offer both Lucent telecommunications equipment products and Southwestern Bell's network solutions in Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Oklahoma and Texas, the company said.
About 170 Lucent sales people will join Southwestern Bell's sales force in selling, on Southwestern Bell's behalf, on-premises switching and call management equipment.
The equipment will be co-branded as Lucent and Southwestern Bell products. The companies said the two brands will result in faster access to new markets for both of them.
Both company's called the deal a "strategy for growth" and projected equipment sales revenues greater than those expected without the relationship.
Southwestern Bell will be the primary agent selling Lucent business communications products in the five states. Southwestern Bell will also continue to sell its telecommunications network services.
Lucent will continue to provide equipment for the federal government, global and small business customers in the region.
Going forward, Southwestern Bell said it will offer only Lucent products in new proposals to large and mid-sized business customers.
Southwestern Bell said it will continue to support its existing business customers who are using products from other suppliers.

The agreement expands Lucent's presence to Southwestern Bell's customer base and broadens Southwestern Bell's ability to offer complete communications systems to its large and mid-sized business customers, including premise and network elements products, the companies said.

Products included under the agreement are Lucent's DEFINITY Enterprise Communications Server and related products and services, such as INTUITY messaging solution, network management services and call center solutions.

Southwestern Bell, a unit of SBC Communications Inc, provides telephone services and products to more than 13.5 million business and residential customers. Lucent provides networks, communications systems and software, business telephone systems and microelectronics components.
